name: 2 to 1 jump box
description: Jump up onto a box with both feet and step or drop down with one. It builds explosive leg power and single-leg control.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms and jump up, landing softly on the box with both feet.
Stand tall on top of the box.
Step down with one leg first, then the other.
Reset and repeat, alternating the leading leg.
